{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm (only 2 rows)
# Since we're computing mean per species, we can drop missing values for this column
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Compute mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = penguins_clean.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Find species with highest mean
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
highest_mean_value = mean_flipper_by_species.max()

print(f'Mean flipper length by species:\n{mean_flipper_by_species}')
print(f'\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {highest_mean_species} ({highest_mean_value:.2f} mm)')"}
